alternatives.argument: The theorem is proved locally by combining the linear-action theorem (proved in full in Brion's Propositions 1.29 and 1.31, Newstead's Theorem 1.12 with its proof in Section 3.4, and Hoskins' Theorems 5.3 and 5.6) with Dolgachev's Theorem 8.1 and Proposition 8.1 (Chapters 7-8, printed pp. 103-121), which give the ample-linearization quotient and its Proj description with complete proofs, and with the local ample-power reduction and chart-gluing lemmas of this batch (equivariant very ample power, affine invariant charts, invariant localization, good-quotient locality on the target, finite generation of the section ring and of its invariants, Proj projectivity, Veronese invariance). No step of the omitted Brion 1.35 proof is left to MFK.
